# Nukind Healthcare

> > Nukind Healthcare is a WHO-GMP, USFDA, and EU-GMP certified pharmaceutical company in India specializing in gastrointestinal health, appetite stimulants, weight management, and digestive wellness products.

Nukind Healthcare manufactures a diverse portfolio of pharmaceutical products including the HUNGERTIME series of appetite stimulants, NUBILACCAP probiotics, NULACSYP digestive solutions, and specialized medications for diabetes and weight management. The company operates across major Indian cities including Delhi, Bangalore, Noida, and Gurugram with strict adherence to international quality standards.

## Key Topics

- WHO-GMP certification
- USFDA and EU-GMP compliance
- Appetite stimulants (Cyproheptadine)
- Gastrointestinal health

- Weight management (Orlistat)
- Pediatric nutrition
- HUNGERTIME product line
- Pharmaceutical manufacturing quality

- Type 2 diabetes treatment
